Compute Match — Email Notiﬁcations
Emails are rendered by the backend ( backend/infrastructure/driven/email/ , templates in
templates/*.html , subjects in subjects.json ). Most are triggered by Temporal workﬂow activities
calling the backend’s System notiﬁcation APIs ( /api/v1/notification/* , scope notification:send ).

Magic links in detail
Recipients: users of the NCP organization with role provider_business_user  and in group
offering-validator . Basic users never receive them.
The backend asks the Keycloak extension endpoint POST /realms/{realm}/clustruffle/create-
action-token  to mint an action token containing the offering id and a nonce.
When clicked, Keycloak validates the nonce with the backend, logs the user in and redirects
with from=magic-link .
Valid 1 hour; resend possible for 7 days after routing.
Magic-link emails use the critical retry policy (10 attempts over about 25 minutes) because
they are the only way an NCP learns about a request.
Reliability
Ordinary notiﬁcations retry 5 times over about 2.5 minutes.
Permanent failures are absorbed (and counted in metric
clustruffle_workflow_activity_abandoned ) so a workﬂow replay never re-sends email to users.
